title: Herbal Soothing Algerian Penne Pasta
description: A fragrant, herbal pasta that blends Mediterranean flavors with Algerian spices, perfect for a comforting hangover cure.

ingredients.name: Spiced herb blend
ingredients.amount: 1 teaspoon (smoked paprika, ground cumin, ground coriander)

instructions: Cook the penne rigate in a large pot of salted boiling water until al dente, about 10 minutes; drain and set aside.
While the pasta cooks, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the minced garlic and diced onion, sautéing until the onion becomes translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and sauté for another 3 minutes, until slightly softened.
Pour in the canned diced tomatoes and vegetable broth, then stir in the spiced herb blend. Bring the mixture to a gentle simmer and let it reduce for 5 minutes to develop flavor.
Add the cooked penne to the skillet, tossing to coat the pasta evenly in the sauce. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley, fresh mint, lemon zest, and lemon juice, allowing the herbs to release their fragrance for 1 minute.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with a drizzle of olive oil or a sprinkle of grated Parmesan if desired. This dish can also be complemented with a side of steamed greens or a light cucumber salad.
